0022600199.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-7, 13th in the East) visit the Dallas Mavericks (5-4, 10th in the West) after dropping their most recent game, while Dallas enters on a one-game winning streak. Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (rest, averaging 12.0 points and 22.9 minutes per game this season), and Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost all three meetings, most recently 123-114 in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026.
